<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da with a strong M+1 (~20 % of M) and diminishing higher‑order peaks—the pattern matches the natural carbon isotopic distribution (C‑12/C‑13). No other element shows such a characteristic pattern at these intensities, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
